cardOverview.overviewText: A Paytm Select variant with HDFC providing elevated rewards on Paytm spends, exclusive partner offers, and milestone perks for loyal users of the Paytm platform.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Up to 20% discount on partner restaurants via Dineout when using your HDFC Bank Credit Card.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the Dineout app or website using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy up to 20% savings at 20,000+ partner restaurants. Complete the payment using your HDFC Paytm Select credit card to unlock the offer.

benefitRows.name: Paytm
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to your Paytm app or website. During subscription or purchase, apply your HDFC Paytm Select credit card details to access premium Paytm services and discounts available through the membership.
